Converse to Learn.

A research collaboration exploring how conversational agents in storybooks and science videos can invite young children to explain, predict, and learn through dialogue.

Visit Converse to Learn →All projects

About the project

Conversation becomes part of the learning experience.

Converse to Learn studies educational uses of AI-based conversational agents for early learning.

Its interactive books and videos encourage children to respond to questions, describe their thinking, and connect new ideas with what they already know. The work brings researchers and community partners together to design experiences for children and families.

LearnersYoung children and their families
FocusEarly literacy, science learning, and dialogue
FormatConversational storybooks and videos

Project approach

Learning by talking ideas through.

Invite Explanation

Prompts ask children to describe what they notice and explain how they reached an idea.

Support Early Learning

Stories and science media create approachable opportunities to practice language and reasoning.

Design With Communities

University and community partners shape learning experiences around the children and families they serve.
